test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: Which of these can be inferred from the passage?

options.text: Extravagance is applauded in some and condemned in others.
Wealthy people are stingy as far as philanthropy is concerned.
For the wealthy, prudence with money is considered a virtue.
People who have a meagre income are expected to be spendthrifts.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Extravagance is applauded in some and condemned in others.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage indicates that an extravagant man is "either admired or loathed" depending on his position in life.
 
• Wealthy individuals are expected to lead luxurious lives and be lavish with their hospitality; failing to do so can harm their reputation.
